name: Maya Tsubura
source: Teaching assistant to Oriyama Hanami and former graduate of school. Was famous student council student body president before her was original shut down because of abuse of power and corruption of its members. As sole member next year was able to successful run events on her own inspiring others to join and bring respect back to position. Her reputation spread like wildfire giving rumors as larger than life figure at school.
